I was working with the and I was working with the and uh, how I could work with Celestate a while because Jennet Kimball, she was about a different family here. And so we made a swap. Mm-hmm. So she played in the Sunday South but now I must not play with Celestate. And now I must be traveling with the wrong way to the south. He didn't want to travel to? No, I want to travel to the wrong way to the south. But he didn't want to travel to? No, I want to travel to…

Can I ask you something about that, that, uh, I hate to interrupt you about this and we can come back to that time, uh, the end of Prohibition, but what did the band leader want? You said they didn't want to lead, they wanted support, huh? Did they want, did they want you to play softly or loud or what?
